episodes.title: Ser Santa tiene su precio
episodes.summary: As Santita's debts grow from her endless generosity and gambling, a wealthy patient arrives at the clinic with a discreet request and a shocking secret.

episodes.title: Los Mandamientos de Santita
episodes.summary: Cecilia's husband rushes to her bedside seeking answers. Meanwhile, Santita gambles with her safety and Lia visits the clinic with trouble of her own.

episodes.title: No estoy para juegos
episodes.summary: Alma takes on risky business to save the clinic. As Santita wrestles with jealousy over Mauricio, Alejandro tries to pull her back into the past.

episodes.title: Errores mejores
episodes.summary: During a trip to the seaside, Santita revisits old memories while Alejandro gathers the courage to ask her something unthinkable.

episodes.title: Conozco el caos
episodes.summary: Tensions rise as Santita confronts Lia, then struggles to keep her own secrets hidden during a dinner date with Mauricio, Cecilia and Alejandro.

episodes.title: Siempre arruinamos las bodas
episodes.summary: At her nephew's wedding, Santita scrambles to balance mounting debt, complicated feelings and her family's future as buried truths threaten everything.

episodes.title: Suerte, doctora
episodes.summary: Explosive revelations leave Santita feeling cornered, and Alejandro's request puts her in an impossible position torn between duty and devotion.
